description: Imports up to 50 dated editorial slots into a LightSpot site's calendar. The import is idempotent: externalId lets you update a slot without creating a duplicate. This action only creates the schedule; it does not generate, schedule or publish any content and consumes no AI credit.

items.description: Slots to show in the LightSpot calendar.

format.description: Editorial format: post, carousel, thread, guide…

notes.description: Angle, goal, CTA or writing instructions.

plannedFor.description: Future date, ISO 8601 with time zone.

platforms.description: Required for SOCIAL, empty or omitted for ARTICLE.

name: create_editorial_calendar
title: Create or update an editorial calendar
